escalation.rule: first search exhausted → E2 late hold (planned TD + 0.3 s) → failed touchdown → the bounded search CONTINUES from the first search end (at rest) down to the planner's turf window's late edge (planner's foothold + (h_B − D_max)), a rest-to-rest quintic with the normal search's peak speed → no contact by its end + 0.3 s → explicit touchdown failure (hold; no further descent)
escalation.deepestPose: the planner's own certified foothold + (h_B − D_max) (reach certified by landingValid / ikFeasible at dz 0)

bounds.impulse50_tickQuantum: plus one tick of the contract-bounded peak load: 0.25·BW·dt_max (per run, N·s)
bounds.torqueRate: E1a-7 at every rate (rate-scaled), whole run
